question: Should maintainers accept this focused iMessage outbound sanitizer hook now, or pause it in favor of a shared outbound sanitizer default for the remaining umbrella work?
rationale: The patch is correct for the iMessage slice, but it intentionally changes delivered text and only maintainer intent can settle the limited false-positive risk versus a broader shared-boundary design.

options.title: Land Focused iMessage Slice
options.body: Accept the limited suppression risk because the patch reuses the established delivery sanitizer, preserves ordinary prose in tests and proof, and matches merged sibling-channel fixes.

options.title: Pause For Shared Default
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want to replace per-channel hooks with one central outbound sanitizer contract before more channel slices land.

recommendation.title: Land Focused iMessage Slice
recommendation.body: Accept the limited suppression risk because the patch reuses the established delivery sanitizer, preserves ordinary prose in tests and proof, and matches merged sibling-channel fixes.
